scope.objective: Reduce the whole-workspace Rust source-edit feedback loop while retaining a linked test-compile lane and test-source coverage.

topology.fanout_reduction: 135 direct integration targets consolidated into 11 compile aggregates (12.3x fewer integration link targets).
topology.coverage_guard: tools/ci/check_rust_test_topology.py validates each direct integration source is explicitly represented once in an aggregate and once as a non-default named legacy target.

baseline.configuration: Pre-consolidation generic test topology in this worktree; profile.test had debug = 0 and incremental = true. This historical command did not enable Core's TQ feature, so its source coverage was narrower than the final complete lane.

fast_source_check_content_edit.trigger: A temporary comment-only edit in crates/hawking-core/src/artifact.rs, restored byte-identically after measurement.
fast_source_check_content_edit.coverage: All 135 direct integration sources, including the seven Core TQ-gated sources, selected in one Cargo feature resolution.

fast_source_check_mtime.coverage: Default-feature aggregate coverage before the final TQ-inclusive one-invocation refinement.

linked_test_compile_mtime.coverage: All 135 direct integration sources, including the seven Core TQ-gated sources, linked in one Cargo feature resolution.

warm_fast_source_check.coverage: All 135 direct integration sources, including the seven Core TQ-gated sources.

validation.topology: python3 tools/ci/check_rust_test_topology.py: passed; 135 direct integration sources across 10 packages
validation.script_syntax: bash -n tools/ci/rust_test_fast.sh and bash -n tools/ci/preflight.sh: passed
validation.fast_check: tools/ci/rust_test_fast.sh check: passed with default and Core TQ feature-gated integration sources in one Cargo invocation
validation.fast_linked_compile: tools/ci/rust_test_fast.sh compile: passed with default and Core TQ feature-gated integration sources in one Cargo invocation
validation.tq_linked_compile: tools/ci/rust_test_fast.sh compile tq: passed; Finished test profile in 22.77s from a cold TQ rebuild
validation.legacy_target: cargo test -p hawking-core --test add_rmsnorm_fused_q8_parity --no-run --message-format short: passed
validation.format: rustfmt --edition 2021 --check passed for every changed Rust source; cargo fmt --all -- --check remains blocked by the pre-existing nested workspace/vendor/strand-quant workspace-resolution defect.

design.artifact_isolation: A tracked worktree-relative .cargo/config.toml gives every linked worktree its own target directory, avoiding shared Cargo artifact locks and incremental-state serialization.
design.default_behavior: autotests = false prevents generic workspace test commands from building or executing an accidental merged runner. Explicit legacy target names remain available for focused runtime tests.
design.coverage_boundary: The fast lanes cover Cargo unit, binary, and direct integration test sources. They do not claim example or doc-test coverage.

claim_boundary: This receipt establishes an offline developer-feedback improvement. It supports a 12.02x measured speedup for a real comment-only Core source edit in the final 135-source TQ-inclusive check lane, and records the earlier 12.82x same-mtime default-feature measurement separately. Because the historical 36.42-second generic baseline did not enable TQ, the 12.02x comparison is a same-worktree feedback reference rather than equal feature coverage. It does not establish a 20x source-edit result, runtime test correctness, model behavior, GPU behavior, daemon behavior, deployment, or performance outside the stated machine and cache state. The remaining Core compiler front-end work is the main measured limit on further safe improvement.
